local CraftingConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("CraftingConfig"))
local TreasureConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("TreasureConfig"))
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local function recipeVisible(r)
	if r.Enabled ~= false then return true end
	return r.TestOnly == true and ServerStorage:GetAttribute("BalanceTestMode") == true -- example recipes: isolated tests only
end
local function spareTreasure(d, id) -- the last copy always stays in the Treasure Book
	return math.max(0, (tonumber((d.Treasures or {})[id]) or 0) - 1)
end
local function rewardValid(rw)
	if type(rw) ~= "table" then return false end
	if rw.Kind == "Boost" then return A.Boosts[rw.Boost] ~= nil end
	if rw.Kind == "Pet" then return PetConfig.PetByName[rw.Pet] ~= nil end
	if rw.Kind == "Treasure" then return TreasureConfig.ById[rw.Treasure] ~= nil end
	if rw.Kind == "Snow" then return (tonumber(rw.Amount) or 0) > 0 end
	return false
end
local function craftList(d)
	local list = {}
	for i, r in ipairs(CraftingConfig.Recipes or {}) do
		if recipeVisible(r) and rewardValid(r.Reward) then
			local items, can = {}, (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) >= (r.Snow or 0)
			for id, need in pairs(r.Treasures or {}) do
				local have = spareTreasure(d, id)
				table.insert(items, {Id = id, Need = need, Have = have})
				if have < need then can = false end
			end
			table.sort(items, function(x, y) return x.Id < y.Id end)
			table.insert(list, {Index = i, Id = r.Id, Name = r.Name, Text = r.Text, Snow = r.Snow or 0, Items = items, Can = can, Reward = r.Reward.Kind})
		end
	end
	local mats = {}
	for id, n in pairs(d.Treasures or {}) do
		local spare = math.max(0, (tonumber(n) or 0) - 1)
		if spare > 0 and TreasureConfig.ById[id] then table.insert(mats, {Id = id, Spare = spare}) end
	end
	table.sort(mats, function(x, y) return x.Id < y.Id end)
	return list, mats
end
local function craft(player, d, index)
	local r = (CraftingConfig.Recipes or {})[tonumber(index) or 0]
	if not (r and recipeVisible(r) and rewardValid(r.Reward)) then return false, "That recipe isn't ready yet" end
	if (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) < (r.Snow or 0) then return false, "Not enough Snow" end
	for id, need in pairs(r.Treasures or {}) do
		if spareTreasure(d, id) < need then
			local t = TreasureConfig.ById[id]
			return false, ("You need %d spare %s"):format(need, t and t.Name or id)
		end
	end
	if (r.Snow or 0) > 0 then DataService.AddSnow(player, -r.Snow) end
	for id, need in pairs(r.Treasures or {}) do d.Treasures[id] -= need end
	local rw = r.Reward
	if rw.Kind == "Boost" then
		Boosts.Add(player, rw.Boost, rw.Seconds or 600)
	elseif rw.Kind == "Pet" then
		d.Pets[rw.Pet] = (d.Pets[rw.Pet] or 0) + 1
		d.PetIndex = d.PetIndex or {}; d.PetIndex[rw.Pet] = true
	elseif rw.Kind == "Treasure" then
		d.TreasureNew = d.TreasureNew or {}
		if (tonumber(d.Treasures[rw.Treasure]) or 0) == 0 then d.TreasureNew[rw.Treasure] = true end
		d.Treasures[rw.Treasure] = (tonumber(d.Treasures[rw.Treasure]) or 0) + 1
	elseif rw.Kind == "Snow" then
		d.Snow = (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0) + rw.Amount -- a prize, not digging income (same as the Lucky Wheel)
		DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
	end
	refreshEvent:FireClient(player)
	return true, "You crafted " .. (r.Name or r.Id) .. "!"
end

local busy = {}

fn.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, a, b)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Still loading..."} end
	d.Pets = d.Pets or {}
	d.EquippedPets = d.EquippedPets or {}
	if action == "Drink" or action == "Fuse" or action == "Craft" then
		local now = os.clock()
		if busy[player] and now - busy[player] < 0.4 then return {Ok = false, Msg = "Slow down!"} end
		busy[player] = now
	end
	-- 2026-10-04 (Claude): the machines are locked until you own their unlock upgrade (UpgradeConfig.MachineUnlocks)
	local need = ({FuserList = "UnlockFuser", Fuse = "UnlockFuser", CraftList = "UnlockCraft", Craft = "UnlockCraft"})[action]
	if need and (tonumber(player:GetAttribute(need)) or 0) < 1 then
		return {Ok = false, Locked = true, Msg = "Locked - unlock it in the Upgrades tree!", List = {}}
	end
	if action == "CocoaList" then
		return {Ok = true, List = cocoaList(d), Snow = d.Snow}
	elseif action == "Drink" then
		local ok, msg = drink(player, d, a)
		return {Ok = ok, Msg = msg, List = cocoaList(d), Snow = d.Snow}
	elseif action == "FuserList" then
		return {Ok = true, List = fuserList(d), Mult = PetConfig.GoldenMult or 2}
	elseif action == "Fuse" then
		local ok, msg, made = fuse(player, d, a)
		return {Ok = ok, Msg = msg, Made = made, List = fuserList(d), Mult = PetConfig.GoldenMult or 2}
	elseif action == "CraftList" then
		local list, mats = craftList(d)
		return {Ok = true, List = list, Mats = mats, Snow = d.Snow}
	elseif action == "Craft" then
		local ok, msg = craft(player, d, a)
		local list, mats = craftList(d)
		return {Ok = ok, Msg = msg, List = list, Mats = mats, Snow = d.Snow}
	end
	return {Ok = false, Msg = "Unknown"}
end

-- PlowRules (2026-10-04, Claude): validates / repairs data.Plow when a profile loads (called from DataService.defaults).
-- Existing profiles keep everything they had; the starter loadout is added; unknown or tampered values are dropped.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("PlowConfig"))
local Rules = {}
local function cleanOffer(o)
	if type(o) ~= "table" or type(o.Part) ~= "string" or not C.Parts[o.Part] or type(o.Token) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local price = tonumber(o.Price)
	if not price or price ~= price or price < 0 then price = C.Parts[o.Part].Price end
	return {Part = o.Part, Token = o.Token, Price = price, Seq = tonumber(o.Seq) or 0}
end
function Rules.Apply(d)
	local p = type(d.Plow) == "table" and d.Plow or {}
	d.Plow = p
	local fresh = type(p.Build) ~= "table"
	local parts = {}
	if type(p.Parts) == "table" then
		for id, n in pairs(p.Parts) do
			if type(id) == "string" and C.Parts[id] and type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= 1 then parts[id] = math.min(math.floor(n), C.Shop.MaxOwned) end
		end
	end
	for _, id in pairs(C.Starter) do if not parts[id] then parts[id] = 1 end end
	p.Parts = parts
	local build = {}
	if fresh then
		for slot, id in pairs(C.Starter) do build[slot] = id end
	else
		for _, slot in ipairs(C.Slots) do
			local id = p.Build[slot]
			if type(id) == "string" and C.Parts[id] and C.Parts[id].Slot == slot and parts[id] then build[slot] = id end
		end
	end
	p.Build = build
	local offers, src = {}, type(p.Offers) == "table" and p.Offers or {}
	for _, k in ipairs({"1", "2", "3"}) do offers[k] = cleanOffer(src[k]) end
	if not offers["1"] then offers["1"] = cleanOffer(p.Offer) end -- an old single offer moves to pedestal 1
	p.Offers, p.Offer = offers, nil
	p.Reserved = cleanOffer(p.Reserved)
	p.Seq = (type(p.Seq) == "number" and p.Seq == p.Seq) and math.floor(p.Seq) or 0
	p.Rolls = (type(p.Rolls) == "number" and p.Rolls == p.Rolls) and math.floor(p.Rolls) or 0
	p.TutorialDone = p.TutorialDone == true
	return d
end
return Rules

local function snapshot(player, d)
	local p = d.Plow
	local function pub(o) if not o then return nil end return {Part = o.Part, Token = o.Token, Price = o.Price} end
	local parts = {}
	for id, n in pairs(p.Parts) do parts[id] = n end

		Driving = Registry.Active[player] ~= nil, TutorialDone = p.TutorialDone == true}

local function pickPart(player, d)
	local luck = math.max(1, (tonumber(d.Luck) or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("LuckMult") or 1))
	local ids = {}
	for id, def in pairs(C.Parts) do if def.Weight > 0 then table.insert(ids, id) end end
	table.sort(ids)
	local w, total = {}, 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		local def = C.Parts[id]
		w[id] = def.Weight * luck ^ (C.Shop.LuckExponent * math.max(0, RANK[def.Rarity] - 2))
		total += w[id]
	end
	local r = rng:NextNumber() * total
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do r -= w[id]; if r <= 0 then return id end end
	return ids[#ids]
end

local function mods(player)
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local ws = hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16
	return {PowerMult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1, PowerBonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0, SizeMult = player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1,
		ReachMult = player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1, SpinMult = player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1, SpeedMult = 1 + math.clamp(ws / 16 - 1, 0, 1) * 0.5}
end
local function flat(v, fallback)
	local f = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	return f.Magnitude > 0.1 and f.Unit or fallback
end
local function findSpawn(char)
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local look = flat(hrp.CFrame.LookVector, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	local rp = RaycastParams.new(); rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, folder}
	local op = OverlapParams.new(); op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; op.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, folder}
	local best
	for _, ang in ipairs({0, 40, -40, 80, -80, 125, -125, 180}) do
		local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ang), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(look)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + dir * C.Vehicle.SpawnAhead + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), rp)
		if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.9 then
			local pos = hit.Position
			local center = pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
			local blocked = false
			for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.lookAt(center, center + dir), Vector3.new(7.5, 3.4, 11), op)) do
				if part.CanCollide then blocked = true break end
			end
			local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + dir)
			if not blocked then return cf end
			best = best or cf
		end
	end
	local p0 = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0) + look * 6
	return best or CFrame.lookAt(p0, p0 + look)
end

local function recover(player, v)
	local hull = v.hull
	if not hull or not hull.Parent then return end
	local cf = v.safeCF or hull.CFrame
	local look = flat(cf.LookVector, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	local pos = cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	pcall(function() hull:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
	v.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look))
	hull.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hull.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	v.lastCF, v.flipSince = nil, nil
	task.delay(0.3, function()
		if hull.Parent and Registry.Active[player] == v then pcall(function() hull:SetNetworkOwner(player) end) end
	end)
end
function despawn(player, reason)
	local v = Registry.Active[player]
	if not v then return end
	Registry.Active[player] = nil
	for _, c in ipairs(v.conns or {}) do c:Disconnect() end
	player:SetAttribute("PlowDriving", false)
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and hum.SeatPart == v.seat then hum.Sit = false end
	if v.model then v.model:Destroy() end
	ev:FireClient(player, "Despawned", reason)
end

	local v = Registry.Active[player]

	local stats = C.StatsFor(v.build, mods(player))
	v.stats = stats

		v.hull:SetAttribute(key, stats[key])
	end

end
local function spawnVehicle(player, d, p)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0) then return fail("Wait until you respawn.") end
	if hum.SeatPart then return fail("You're already sitting somewhere.") end
	local build = p.Build
	if not (build.Engine and build.Gear) then return fail("Your snowplow needs an engine and running gear - open the GARAGE!") end
	local stats = C.StatsFor(build, mods(player))
	local rootCF = findSpawn(char)
	local ok, model = pcall(Assembly.Build, build)
	if not ok or not model then return fail("The snowplow parts are missing - tell the developer.") end
	model.Name = "Snowplow_" .. player.UserId
	model:PivotTo(rootCF)
	local seatRel = model:GetAttribute("SeatPos")
	local hs = C.Vehicle.HullSize
	local hull = Instance.new("Part")
	hull.Name = "Hull"; hull.Size = hs; hull.Transparency = 1
	hull.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, C.Vehicle.HullClearance + hs.Y / 2, 0)
	hull.CanCollide, hull.CanQuery, hull.CanTouch = true, false, false
	hull.CollisionGroup = "PlowVehicle"
	hull.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.6, 0, 0, 100, 1)
	hull.Parent = model
	local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
	seat.Name = "DriverSeat"; seat.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 0.6, 2.4); seat.Transparency = 1
	seat.CanCollide, seat.CanQuery, seat.CanTouch = false, false, false
	seat.CFrame = model.PrimaryPart.CFrame * (seatRel or CFrame.new(0, 3, 1)) * CFrame.new(0, -0.3, 0)
	seat.Parent = model
	local function weld(part)
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); w.Part0 = hull; w.Part1 = part; w.Parent = part
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hull then
			part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery, part.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
			weld(part)
		end
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = hull
	hull.Anchored = false
	hull:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	hull:SetAttribute("MaxSpeed", stats.MaxSpeed); hull:SetAttribute("Accel", stats.Accel); hull:SetAttribute("TurnRate", stats.TurnRate)
	hull:SetAttribute("Traction", stats.Traction); hull:SetAttribute("Stability", stats.Stability); hull:SetAttribute("Pivot", stats.Pivot)
	model.Parent = folder
	local v = {model = model, hull = hull, seat = seat, stats = stats, build = {Blade = build.Blade, Engine = build.Engine, Gear = build.Gear},
		safeCF = hull.CFrame, spawnedAt = os.clock(), flags = 0, conns = {}}
	Registry.Active[player] = v
	player:SetAttribute("PlowDriving", true)
	table.insert(v.conns, hum.Died:Connect(function() despawn(player, "died") end))
	seat:Sit(hum)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.0 and hum.SeatPart ~= seat and Registry.Active[player] == v do task.wait(0.05) end
	if Registry.Active[player] ~= v then return fail("Couldn't hop in - try again.") end
	if hum.SeatPart ~= seat then despawn(player, "seat failed"); return fail("Couldn't hop in - try again.") end

local actions = {}
function actions.State() return {ok = true} end
local SLOTS = {["1"] = true, ["2"] = true, ["3"] = true}
function actions.Roll(player, d, p, slot)
	slot = tostring(slot or "1")
	if not SLOTS[slot] then return fail("Bad request") end
	if not player:GetAttribute("InGarage") then return fail("Parts are rolled on the pedestals in the GARAGE - tap GARAGE to teleport there!") end
	if (cooldown[player] or 0) > os.clock() then return fail("Rolling too fast - one moment!") end
	cooldown[player] = os.clock() + C.Shop.RollCooldown * math.clamp(player:GetAttribute("RollCooldownMult") or 1, 0.6, 1)
	local id = pickPart(player, d)
	p.Seq += 1
	p.Rolls += 1
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Rolls", (d.TotalRolls or 0) + p.Rolls)
	p.Offers[slot] = {Part = id, Token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), Price = C.Parts[id].Price, Seq = p.Seq}
	player:SetAttribute("PlowOffered", true)
	return {ok = true, rolled = true, slot = slot, rank = RANK[C.Parts[id].Rarity]}
end
actions.Reroll = actions.Roll
function actions.Buy(player, d, p, which, token)
	if which ~= "Reserved" and not SLOTS[which] then return fail("Bad request") end
	local o = which == "Reserved" and p.Reserved or p.Offers[which]
	if type(token) ~= "string" or not o or o.Token ~= token then return fail("That offer is gone - roll a new one!", {stale = true}) end
	local def = C.Parts[o.Part]
	if not def then
		if which == "Reserved" then p.Reserved = nil else p.Offers[which] = nil end
		return fail("That part no longer exists.")
	end
	local price = o.Price
	if type(d.Snow) ~= "number" or d.Snow ~= d.Snow or d.Snow < price then
		local short = math.ceil(price - (tonumber(d.Snow) or 0))
		return fail("You need " .. Format.Abbreviate(short) .. " more Snow", {short = short})
	end
	if (p.Parts[o.Part] or 0) >= C.Shop.MaxOwned then return fail("You own the maximum of this part.") end
	-- deduct + grant + clear in one step (no yield in between): a duplicate or forged request can never buy twice
	d.Snow -= price
	DataService.SetStat(player, "Snow", d.Snow)
	p.Parts[o.Part] = (p.Parts[o.Part] or 0) + 1
	if which == "Reserved" then p.Reserved = nil else p.Offers[which] = nil end
	player:SetAttribute("PlowBought", true)
	return {ok = true, bought = o.Part, msg = "Bought " .. def.Name .. "!"}
end
function actions.Reserve(player, d, p, slot, token, confirm)
	slot = tostring(slot or "")
	if not SLOTS[slot] then return fail("Bad request") end
	local o = p.Offers[slot]
	if type(token) ~= "string" or not o or o.Token ~= token then return fail("That offer is gone - roll a new one!", {stale = true}) end
	if p.Reserved and confirm ~= true then return fail("Replace your reserved part?", {needConfirm = true}) end
	p.Reserved = o
	p.Offers[slot] = nil
	return {ok = true, msg = "Reserved " .. C.Parts[o.Part].Name .. "!"}
end
function actions.Equip(player, d, p, slot, id)
	if type(slot) ~= "string" or type(id) ~= "string" then return fail("Bad request") end
	local def = C.Parts[id]
	if not def or def.Slot ~= slot or not table.find(C.Slots, slot) then return fail("That part doesn't fit that slot.") end
	if (p.Parts[id] or 0) < 1 then return fail("You don't own that part.") end
	if Registry.Active[player] then return fail("Park your snowplow first (EXIT), then change parts.") end
	p.Build[slot] = id
	player:SetAttribute("PlowEquipped", true)
	return {ok = true, msg = def.Name .. " equipped!"}
end
function actions.Unequip(player, d, p, slot)
	if type(slot) ~= "string" or not table.find(C.Slots, slot) then return fail("Bad request") end
	if Registry.Active[player] then return fail("Park your snowplow first (EXIT), then change parts.") end
	p.Build[slot] = nil
	return {ok = true, msg = "Unequipped - the part stays in your inventory."}
end
function actions.Drive(player, d, p)
	if player:GetAttribute("InGarage") then return fail("Go back to the lobby to drive - tap LOBBY!") end
	if Registry.Active[player] then despawn(player, "exit"); return {ok = true, driving = false} end
	return spawnVehicle(player, d, p)
end
function actions.Recover(player)
	local v = Registry.Active[player]
	if not v then return fail("You're not driving.") end
	if (v.recoverAt or 0) > os.clock() then return fail("Recover is cooling down...") end
	v.recoverAt = os.clock() + C.Vehicle.RecoverCooldown
	recover(player, v)
	return {ok = true, msg = "Snowplow recovered!"}
end

-- Pure server-side transaction rules; no yields occur between validation and reset.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local R = require(RS:WaitForChild("RebirthConfig"))
local Pets = require(RS:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local Upgrades = require(RS:WaitForChild("UpgradeConfig"))
local Rules = {}

function Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not d then return false, "Your progress is still loading." end
 if type(expected) ~= "number" or expected ~= R.Count(d.Rebirths) then
  return false, "Your rebirth changed. Check the rewards and try again."
 end
 local req = R.Requirement(d.Rebirths)
 if not req then return false, "You reached the maximum rebirth level!" end
 -- 2026-10-04 (Claude): no stage requirement any more - a rebirth only needs the Snow cost (RebirthConfig.Milestones[].Cost)
 if type(d.Snow) ~= "number" or d.Snow ~= d.Snow or d.Snow == math.huge or d.Snow < req.Cost then
  return false, "You need more Snow to rebirth."
 end
 return true, req
end

local function equippedAfterReset(list, owned, byName, slots, score)
 local clean, used = {}, {}
 for _, name in ipairs(list or {}) do
  if byName[name] and (used[name] or 0) < (owned[name] or 0) then
   used[name] = (used[name] or 0) + 1
   table.insert(clean, name)
  end
 end
 table.sort(clean, function(a, b) return score(byName[a]) > score(byName[b]) end)
 while #clean > slots do table.remove(clean) end
 return clean
end

function Rules.Apply(d, expected)
 local ok, req = Rules.Check(d, expected)
 if not ok then return false, req end
 -- 2026-10-03 (Claude): upgrades are KEPT on rebirth (user request), so the equip slots they give stay too.
 -- Compute current pet equipment before changing the profile; the plow build remains owned/equipped.
 local kept = Upgrades.Calculate(d.Upgrades or {}, 0)
 local pets = equippedAfterReset(d.EquippedPets, d.Pets, Pets.PetByName, kept.PetSlots or Upgrades.Base.PetSlots, function(x) return x.Boost end)
 d.Rebirths = req.Level
 d.Snow = 0
 d.Stages = {}
 -- d.Upgrades is kept (2026-10-03; it used to be reset here)
 d.EquippedPets = pets
 -- Plow parts/build/offers, historical Counts/Equipped, upgrades, pets, settings and lifetime rolls are preserved.
 return true, req
end
return Rules

 stats.SnowMult *= snow

-- SnowFieldService: PERSONAL fields with tile HP.
-- Each tile has a phase (0-3 layers left) and HP for its top layer.
-- The snowplow blade deals clearing damage to each contacted tile; at 0 HP the layer breaks and pays out.
-- Updates are sent only to the owning player as triples: index, phase, hpPercent.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local treasureModule = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("TreasureService")
local okTreasures, Treasures = false, nil
if treasureModule then okTreasures, Treasures = pcall(require, treasureModule) end
if not okTreasures then warn("[SnowFieldService] TreasureService unavailable: " .. tostring(Treasures)); Treasures = nil end
local treasureWarned = false
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldUpdate")
local syncFunc = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldSync")
local collectedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowCollected")
local PlowConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlowConfig"))
local PlowRegistry = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PlowRegistry"))

local TICK = 0.2
local TS = SF.TileSize
local MAX = SF.MaxPhase

local defs = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	defs[f.Id] = {def = f, origin = SF.Origin(f), maxHP = math.max(1, f.TileHP or 1)}
end

-- states[player][fieldId] = {phases = {}, hp = {}, pending = {}}
local states = {}
local function getStates(player)
	local st = states[player]
	if not st then
		st = {}
		for id, d in pairs(defs) do
			local n = d.def.Width * d.def.Depth
			st[id] = {phases = table.create(n, MAX), hp = table.create(n, d.maxHP), pending = {}}
		end
		states[player] = st
	end
	return st
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	states[p] = nil
end)

local function pct(hp, maxHP) return math.clamp(math.floor(hp / maxHP * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100) end

syncFunc.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local out = {}
	for id, s in pairs(getStates(player)) do
		local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
		local hp = table.create(#s.hp, 100)
		for i, v in ipairs(s.hp) do hp[i] = pct(v, maxHP) end
		out[id] = {p = table.concat(s.phases), h = hp}
	end
	return out
end

local function flush(player, st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		if next(s.pending) then
			local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
			local flat = {}
			for i in pairs(s.pending) do
				flat[#flat + 1] = i
				flat[#flat + 1] = s.phases[i]
				flat[#flat + 1] = pct(s.hp[i], maxHP)
			end
			s.pending = {}
			updateEvent:FireClient(player, id, flat)
		end
	end
end

-- Dig combo (2026-10-04, Claude, v2): grows with TIME spent digging without a pause, not per payout. Level n needs
-- COMBO_SECONDS * n^1.25 s (level 10 ~45 s, max level 20 = x2 Snow ~1 min 45 s); a COMBO_WINDOW pause resets it.
local COMBO_WINDOW, COMBO_STEP, COMBO_MAX, COMBO_SECONDS = 2.5, 0.05, 20, 2.5
local combos = {}
game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) combos[p] = nil end)

-- Only the vehicle's blade clears fields. Everything is computed here from the server's own copy of the build,
-- the replicated hull position and the clock - nothing the client reports.
local function payoutPlow(player, gained, layers, now)
	local pets = {}
	for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
	gained = math.max(1, math.floor(gained * (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) + 0.5))
	local c = combos[player] or {start = now, last = 0, count = 0}
	if now - c.last > COMBO_WINDOW then c.start = now end
	c.last = now
	c.count = math.min(COMBO_MAX, math.floor(((now - c.start) / COMBO_SECONDS) ^ 0.8))
	combos[player] = c
	local comboMult = 1 + c.count * COMBO_STEP
	gained = math.floor(gained * comboMult + 0.5)
	player:SetAttribute("Combo", c.count)
	DataService.AddSnow(player, gained)
	collectedEvent:FireClient(player, gained, c.count, layers, comboMult)
end
local function collect(player, st, now)
	if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") then return end
	local v = PlowRegistry.Active[player]
	if not v or not v.hull or not v.hull.Parent then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.SeatPart ~= v.seat then v.lastCF = nil return end
	local cf = v.hull.CFrame
	if (root.Position - cf.Position).Magnitude > PlowConfig.Vehicle.MaxRiderGap then v.lastCF = nil return end
	local prevCF, prevT = v.lastCF, v.lastT
	v.lastCF, v.lastT = cf, now
	if not prevCF then return end
	local dt = now - prevT
	if dt < 0.02 or dt > 1.2 then return end
	local move = Vector3.new(cf.X - prevCF.X, 0, cf.Z - prevCF.Z).Magnitude
	local stats, CL = v.stats, PlowConfig.Clearing
	if move / dt > stats.MaxSpeed * CL.SpeedTolerance + 8 then v.flags = (v.flags or 0) + 1 return end -- implausible movement: no clearing this tick
	if not stats.HasBlade or stats.ClearPower <= 0 then return end
	local W, off = stats.BladeWidth, PlowConfig.Vehicle.BladeOffset
	local half, halfD = W / 2 + TS * CL.TileSlack, CL.BladeDepth / 2 + TS * CL.TileSlack
	local K = math.clamp(math.ceil(move / (TS * 0.5)) + 1, 1, 12)
	local slice = dt / K
	local gained, layers = 0, 0
	for id, d in pairs(defs) do
		local f, origin, maxHP = d.def, d.origin, d.maxHP
		if f.Style and f.Style ~= "Starter" and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. f.Style) ~= true then continue end -- stage locked
		local lx, lz = cf.X - origin.X, cf.Z - origin.Z
		local m = W + off + 8
		if lx > -m and lz > -m and lx < f.Width * TS + m and lz < f.Depth * TS + m and math.abs(cf.Y - origin.Y) < 14 then
			local s = st[id]
			local tough = math.clamp((math.log10(maxHP) - CL.ToughLow) / CL.ToughSpan, 0, 1)
			local dmgPerSlice = stats.ClearPower * (stats.Soft + (stats.Hard - stats.Soft) * tough) * slice
			local contact = {}
			for k = 1, K do
				local c = prevCF:Lerp(cf, k / K)
				local lv = c.LookVector
				local fl = math.sqrt(lv.X * lv.X + lv.Z * lv.Z)
				if fl > 1e-3 then
					local fx, fz = lv.X / fl, lv.Z / fl
					local rx, rz = -fz, fx
					local cx, cz = c.X + fx * off - origin.X, c.Z + fz * off - origin.Z
					local hx = math.abs(rx) * half + math.abs(fx) * halfD
					local hz = math.abs(rz) * half + math.abs(fz) * halfD
					local x0, x1 = math.max(0, math.floor((cx - hx) / TS)), math.min(f.Width - 1, math.floor((cx + hx) / TS))
					local z0, z1 = math.max(0, math.floor((cz - hz) / TS)), math.min(f.Depth - 1, math.floor((cz + hz) / TS))
					for x = x0, x1 do
						for z = z0, z1 do
							local i = z * f.Width + x + 1
							if s.phases[i] > 0 then
								local dx, dz = (x + 0.5) * TS - cx, (z + 0.5) * TS - cz
								if math.abs(dx * fx + dz * fz) <= halfD and math.abs(dx * rx + dz * rz) <= half then contact[i] = (contact[i] or 0) + 1 end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			for i, n in pairs(contact) do
				local hp = s.hp[i] - dmgPerSlice * n
				local p = s.phases[i]
				while hp <= 0 and p > 0 do p -= 1; gained += f.SnowPerPhase; layers += 1; hp += maxHP end
				if p == 0 then
					hp = maxHP
					if Treasures then
						local x, z = (i - 1) % f.Width, math.floor((i - 1) / f.Width)
						local okT, errT = pcall(Treasures.TileCleared, player, f, SF.TileCenter(f, x, z))
						if not okT and not treasureWarned then treasureWarned = true; warn("[Treasures] " .. tostring(errT)) end
					end
				end
				s.phases[i] = p
				s.hp[i] = hp
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
	if gained > 0 then payoutPlow(player, gained, layers, now) end
end

local function regrow(st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		local d = defs[id]
		local chance = 1 / d.def.RegrowSeconds
		for i, p in ipairs(s.phases) do
			if p < MAX and math.random() < chance then
				s.phases[i] = p + 1
				s.hp[i] = d.maxHP
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

buy.OnServerInvoke = function(player, id)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	local n = type(id) == "string" and U.ById[id]
	if not d or not n then return false, "Unknown" end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastBuy[player] and now - lastBuy[player] < 0.15 then return false, "Slow down" end
	lastBuy[player] = now
	local set = owned(d)
	if set[id] then return false, "Owned" end
	local reason = U.LockReason(n, set, d.Stages)
	if reason then return false, reason end
	local cost = U.CostOf(n)
	if d.Snow < cost then return false, "Not enough snow" end
	DataService.AddSnow(player, -cost)
	d.Upgrades[id] = true
	apply(player)
	return true

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- 3D pet preview inside a frame
local function viewport(parent, petName, props)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
		LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do vp[k] = v end
	local m = PetModels.create(petName)
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	m.Parent = vp
	local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 1.7 + 1.5
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(dist * 0.45, dist * 0.25, -dist), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	vp.Parent = parent
	return vp, m
end

local function send(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true

	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then equipped = res; refresh() end
end

refresh = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(petContent:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local order, any = 0, false
	for _, egg in ipairs(PetConfig.Eggs) do

-- New 2026 egg art: clone the Shell mesh from the lobby EggDisplay; old procedural eggs are the fallback.
local function eggArt(eggId)
	local display = workspace:FindFirstChild("EggDisplay", true)
	local src = display and display:FindFirstChild(eggId)
	if not (src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")) then
		-- World 2 eggs (2026-10-02, Claude) stand in their own stages, not in the lobby EggDisplay
		for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == eggId and d:FindFirstChild("Shell") then src = d; break end
		end
	end
	local shell = src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shell and shell:IsA("MeshPart") then
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = eggId
		local c = shell:Clone()
		c.Anchored = true
		c.PivotOffset = CFrame.new() -- imported meshes carry a 90-degree pivot; keep the egg upright
		c.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		c.Parent = m
		m.PrimaryPart = c
		-- World 2 eggs: decoration parts tagged EggArt (petals, bands...) follow the shell
		for _, d in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("EggArt") then
				local e = d:Clone()
				e.Anchored = true
				e.CFrame = shell.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(d.CFrame)
				e.Parent = m
			end
		end
		return m
	end
	return EggModels.create(eggId)
end

local playing = false
local function playHatch(eggId, petName, isNew)
	playing = true
	for _, c in ipairs(stage:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end end
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	overlay.Visible = true
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tween(overlay, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.45})
	tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = 18})

	-- the egg: a clone of the real egg model if possible
	local eggVp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21,
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, stage)
	local eggModel = eggArt(eggId)
	eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	eggModel.Parent = eggVp
	local _, size = eggModel:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.15, -math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = eggVp
	eggVp.CurrentCamera = cam
	topText.Text = "Hatching..."

	-- shake harder and harder
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.6 do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 1.6
		eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (0.08 + k * 0.28)))
		task.wait()
	end

	-- pop!
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tween(flash, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	eggVp:Destroy()
	local pet = PetConfig.PetByName[petName]
	local color = pet and PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local vp, model = viewport(stage, petName, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21})
	local popScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0.3}, stage)
	tween(popScale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	topText.Text = isNew and "NEW PET!" or "You hatched"
	topText.TextColor3 = isNew and Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 90) or WHITE
	nameText.Text = petName
	nameText.TextColor3 = color
	subText.Text = (pet and pet.Rarity or "") .. "  •  +" .. math.floor((pet and pet.Boost or 0) * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄"
	subText.TextColor3 = WHITE

	local t1 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t1 < 2.4 do
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, (os.clock() - t1) * 1.5, 0))
		task.wait()
	end
	tween(overlay, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(0.3)
	popScale:Destroy()
	vp:Destroy()
	overlay.Visible = false
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	playing = false
end

local function makeSign(prompt)
	local part = prompt.Parent
	if not part then return end
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while model and not PetConfig.EggById[model.Name] do model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") end
	if not model then return end
	local egg = PetConfig.EggById[model.Name]
	local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	if pg:FindFirstChild("PetSign_" .. egg.Id) then return end
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()

	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "PetSign_" .. egg.Id
	bb.Adornee = part
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 205)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 4.8, 0)
	-- lobby row eggs (Shell on a pedestal): sit the panel just above the egg itself
	local shellPart = model:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shellPart and shellPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		local eggTop = shellPart.Position.Y + shellPart.Size.Y / 2 - part.Position.Y
		bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, eggTop + 1.3, 0)
		bb.SizeOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	end
	bb.MaxDistance = 1000
	bb.Enabled = false -- shown by the proximity loop below
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	bb.ResetOnSpawn = false

	local frame = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 30, 55), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, bb)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)}, frame)
	-- Transparent outer panel; preserve pet tiles, text, odds and layout.
	label(frame, egg.Name:upper() .. "  •  " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(egg.Cost) .. " ❄", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26)}, 2)

	local grid = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -44)}, frame)
	mk("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 78), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, grid)

	local entry = {slots = {}, bb = bb, part = part, shown = false, scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0}, frame)}
	for i, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
		local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
		local cell = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i}, grid)
		local tile = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = color, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)}, cell)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, tile)
		mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), color), Rotation = 90}, tile)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, tile)
		local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, tile)
		local vp = viewport(tile, pet.Name, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
		label(cell, pet.Chance .. "%", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 58), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)}, 2)
		entry.slots[pet.Name] = {vp = vp, scale = scale}
	end
	signs[egg.Id] = entry
	bb.Parent = pg
	updateSigns()
end

-- egg signs only show when you're close; they pop in and shrink away
local SHOW_DISTANCE = 25
local HIDE_DISTANCE = 30
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		-- eggs stand close together in the lobby row: only the nearest egg's sign may show
		local nearest, nearestDist = nil, math.huge
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent and hrp then
				local d = (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude
				if d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = entry, d end
			end
		end
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
				local dist = hrp and (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
				if entry ~= nearest then dist = math.huge end
				if not entry.shown and dist < SHOW_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = true
					entry.bb.Enabled = true
					entry.scale.Scale = 0
					tween(entry.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				elseif entry.shown and dist > HIDE_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = false
					local tw = tween(entry.scale, 0.2, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					tw.Completed:Connect(function()
						if not entry.shown then entry.bb.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)

-- STATE
local confirming, expected, busy, ready = false, nil, false, false
local feedback, feedbackGood = "", false
local function mult(n)
	local s = ("%.2f"):format(n)
	s = s:gsub("0+$", "")
	s = s:gsub("%.$", "")
	return "x" .. s
end
local function snow()
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	return ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Snow") and ls.Snow.Value or 0
end
local pulseConn
local function setPulse(on)
	if on and not pulseConn then
		pulseConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			buyScale.Scale = 1 + 0.035 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(os.clock() * 4.5))
		end)
	elseif not on and pulseConn then
		pulseConn:Disconnect(); pulseConn = nil; buyScale.Scale = 1
	end
end

local function refresh()
	local raw = player:GetAttribute("Rebirths")
	local count = R.Count(raw)
	local req = R.Requirement(count)
	local a, b = R.Multipliers(count)
	local na, nb = R.Multipliers(req and req.Level or count)
	snowNow.Text, snowBonus.Text, snowPlus.Text = mult(a), mult(na), "+" .. mult(na - a):sub(2)
	luckNow.Text, luckBonus.Text, luckPlus.Text = mult(b), mult(nb), "+" .. mult(nb - b):sub(2)
	snowPlus.Parent.Visible, luckPlus.Parent.Visible = req ~= nil, req ~= nil
	doneLabel.Text = count .. " / " .. R.MaxRebirths .. " DONE"
	countLabel.Text = req and ("NEXT: REBIRTH " .. req.Level) or "MAX REBIRTH!"
	local have = snow()
	ready = raw ~= nil and req ~= nil and have >= req.Cost -- 2026-10-04 (Claude): no stage requirement, only the Snow cost
	if req then
		price.Text = "Snow " .. Format.Abbreviate(have) .. " / " .. Format.Abbreviate(req.Cost)
		local k = math.clamp(have / req.Cost, 0, 1)
		fill.Size = S(k, 1)
		fill.Visible = k > 0.002
		fillGrad.Color = k >= 1 and ColorSequence.new(C(150, 240, 170), C(50, 185, 95)) or ColorSequence.new(C(140, 225, 255), C(60, 160, 240))
	else
		price.Text = "All milestones done! Enjoy your permanent bonuses!"
		fill.Size = S(1, 1); fill.Visible = true
		fillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(C(150, 240, 170), C(50, 185, 95))
	end
	if confirming and (expected ~= count or not ready) then confirming = false end
	cancel.Visible = confirming
	buy.Position = confirming and S(0.33, 0.81) or S(0.12, 0.81)
	buy.Size = confirming and S(0.67, 0.19) or S(0.76, 0.19)
	buyText.Text = busy and "REBIRTHING..." or confirming and "CONFIRM RESET" or not req and "MAX REBIRTH" or ready and "REBIRTH!" or "NOT READY YET"
	buyGrad.Color = (ready and confirming) and ColorSequence.new(C(255, 125, 145), C(205, 50, 85))
		or ready and ColorSequence.new(C(190, 120, 255), PURPLE)
		or ColorSequence.new(C(178, 185, 204), C(132, 140, 165))
	subtitle.Text = feedback ~= "" and feedback
		or confirming and "Snow and stages reset. Upgrades, vehicle parts and pets stay!"
		or ready and "You're ready! Start over stronger - bonuses are permanent."
		or "Start over stronger - your bonuses are permanent!"
	subtitle.TextColor3 = feedback ~= "" and (feedbackGood and C(190, 255, 205) or C(255, 205, 215)) or confirming and C(255, 205, 215) or WHITE -- light colours on the purple strip
	setPulse(panel.Visible and ready and not busy and not confirming)
end

local function shake()
	local base = buy.Position
	for i, dx in ipairs({-0.012, 0.012, -0.008, 0.008, 0}) do
		task.delay(i * 0.04, function() if not confirming then buy.Position = base + S(dx, 0) end end)
	end
end
local CONFETTI = {C(255, 220, 60), C(90, 255, 130), C(80, 190, 255), C(255, 90, 170), C(190, 120, 255)}
local function confetti()
	local origin = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.9)
	for i = 1, 18 do
		local ang = math.rad(200 + (i / 18) * 140)
		local dist = 0.18 + math.random() * 0.25
		local piece = box(content, "Confetti", S(origin.X, origin.Y), S(0.018, 0.03), CONFETTI[i % #CONFETTI + 1])
		piece.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); piece.Rotation = math.random(0, 90); piece.ZIndex = 10
		corner(piece, UDim.new(0.3, 0))
		TweenService:Create(piece, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Position = S(origin.X + math.cos(ang) * dist, origin.Y + math.sin(ang) * dist * 1.6),
			Rotation = piece.Rotation + 220, BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.delay(0.75, function() piece:Destroy() end)
	end
end

buy.Activated:Connect(function()
	if busy then return end
	local count = R.Count(player:GetAttribute("Rebirths"))
	local req = R.Requirement(count)
	if not req or snow() < req.Cost then shake() return end
	if not confirming then confirming = true expected = count feedback = "" refresh() return end
	busy = true refresh()
	local ok, success, message = pcall(function() return request:InvokeServer(expected) end)
	busy = false confirming = false
	feedback = ok and tostring(message or "Please try again.") or "Connection problem. Please try again."
	feedbackGood = false
	if ok and success then
		feedback = "REBIRTH COMPLETE! Your permanent boosts are active."
		feedbackGood = true
		local scale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if scale then scale.Scale = 0.94 TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Scale = 1}):Play() end
		confetti()
	end
	refresh()
end)

end)

-- 1) a pulsing red "!" on the REBIRTH menu button for as long as you can afford it
-- 2) a purple banner once per rebirth level and session (tap it to open the Rebirth menu); it waits for intros, cutscenes and the Upgrades page
do
	local menuButton = gui:WaitForChild("LeftMenu"):WaitForChild("RebirthButton")
	local dot = make("TextLabel", {Name = "ReadyDot", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = S(0.86, 0.14), Size = S(0.3, 0.3),
		BackgroundColor3 = C(255, 70, 80), Text = "!", Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6}, menuButton)
	make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, dot)
	make("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2, Color = WHITE}, dot)
	local banner = make("TextButton", {Name = "RebirthReadyBanner", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = S(0.5, 0.3),
		Size = S(0.46, 0.09), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 40}, gui)
	banner:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.3, 0)}, banner)
	make("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, banner)
	make("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(C(190, 120, 255), PURPLE)}, banner)
	local bannerScale = make("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, banner)
	local bannerTitle = make("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, Text = "\u{1F504} REBIRTH READY!", TextColor3 = WHITE,
		Position = S(0.04, 0.06), Size = S(0.92, 0.5), ZIndex = 41}, banner)
	make("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = NAVY}, bannerTitle)
	local bannerSub = make("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, Text = "Tap here to start over stronger", TextColor3 = C(238, 228, 255),
		Position = S(0.04, 0.58), Size = S(0.92, 0.34), ZIndex = 41}, banner)
	make("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2, Color = NAVY}, bannerSub)

	local function blocked()
		if player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") or player:GetAttribute("IntroPlaying") then return true end
		local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		local rd = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("RareDropGui")
		if rd and rd.Enabled then return true end
		local upg = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("UpgradeTreeGui")
		return upg ~= nil and upg.Enabled
	end
	local function canRebirth()
		local raw = player:GetAttribute("Rebirths")
		local count = R.Count(raw)
		local req = R.Requirement(count)
		return raw ~= nil and req ~= nil and snow() >= req.Cost, count
	end
	local announced, token = nil, 0
	local function announce()
		token += 1
		local my = token
		task.spawn(function()
			local waited = 0
			while blocked() and waited < 120 do task.wait(0.5); waited += 0.5 end
			if token ~= my or panel.Visible or not canRebirth() then return end
			banner.Visible = true
			bannerScale.Scale = 0.4
			TweenService:Create(bannerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
			task.wait(7)
			if token ~= my then return end
			TweenService:Create(bannerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0}):Play()
			task.wait(0.3)
			if token == my then banner.Visible = false end
		end)
	end
	local function check()
		local can, count = canRebirth()
		dot.Visible = can
		if can and announced ~= count then
			announced = count
			announce()
		end
	end
	banner.Activated:Connect(function()
		token += 1
		banner.Visible = false
		local openMenu = gui:FindFirstChild("VillageOpenMenu")
		if openMenu then openMenu:Fire("Rebirth") end
	end)
	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if panel.Visible then token += 1; banner.Visible = false end
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Rebirths"):Connect(check)
	task.spawn(function() player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Snow").Changed:Connect(check) end)
	task.spawn(function() -- the "!" pulses like the one on the Rewards button
		while true do
			if dot.Visible then
				TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Size = S(0.36, 0.36)}):Play()
				task.wait(0.45)
				TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Size = S(0.3, 0.3)}):Play()
				task.wait(0.45)
			else
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end
	end)
	check()
end

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function bounce(btn)
	local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then return end
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.1}) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.88}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.25, {Scale = 1.1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
blur.Name, blur.Size, blur.Parent = "MenuBlur", 0, workspace.CurrentCamera
local openPanel
local function showPanel(p)
	local s = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	p.Visible = true
	if s then s.Scale = 0.5; tween(s, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end
end
local function hidePanel(p)
	local s = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if s then
		tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 0.5}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In).Completed:Connect(function()
			if openPanel ~= p then p.Visible = false end
		end)
	else p.Visible = false end
end
local function setBlur(on) tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = on and 16 or 0}) end
local function togglePanel(name)
	local target = panels:FindFirstChild(name or "")
	if not target then return end
	if openPanel then hidePanel(openPanel) end
	if openPanel == target then openPanel = nil; setBlur(false); return end
	openPanel = target
	showPanel(target)
	setBlur(true)
end
local function closeAll()
	if openPanel then hidePanel(openPanel); openPanel = nil; setBlur(false) end
end
gui:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu").Event:Connect(function(name)
	if name == "Upgrades" then closeAll(); return end
	if name == "Pets" then name = "Inventory" end
	local target = panels:FindFirstChild(name or "")
	if target and openPanel ~= target then togglePanel(name) end
end)

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function label(parent, name, text, pos, size, color)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Name = name, Text = text, Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = true,
		TextColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = pos, Size = size}, parent)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2, Color = OUTLINE}, l)
	mk("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 22}, l)
	return l
end
local colors = {}
for _, r in ipairs(C.Rarities) do colors[r.Id] = r.Color end
local ids, slotOrder = {}, {}
for i, slot in ipairs(C.Slots) do slotOrder[slot] = i end
for id in pairs(C.Parts) do table.insert(ids, id) end
table.sort(ids, function(a, b)
	local x, y = C.Parts[a], C.Parts[b]
	if x.Slot ~= y.Slot then return (slotOrder[x.Slot] or 99) < (slotOrder[y.Slot] or 99) end
	if x.Price ~= y.Price then return x.Price < y.Price end
	return a < b
end)
local index = panels:WaitForChild("Index")
local content = index:WaitForChild("Inner"):WaitForChild("Content")
local lastSignature
local function partCard(id, order, state)
	local def = C.Parts[id]
	local count = math.max(0, tonumber(state.Parts and state.Parts[id]) or 0)
	local owned = count > 0
	local equipped = state.Build and state.Build[def.Slot] == id
	local color = owned and (colors[def.Rarity] or WHITE) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 185)
	local holder = mk("Frame", {Name = id, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, content)
	holder:SetAttribute("PartId", id)
	holder:SetAttribute("Owned", owned)
	holder:SetAttribute("Equipped", equipped == true)
	local main = mk("Frame", {Name = "Main", BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	main:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.16, 0)}, main)
	mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), color)}, main)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		Color = equipped and Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 90) or color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45)}, main)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {Name = "PartPreview", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.03),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.43), Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), LightColor = WHITE,
		LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, main)
	local model = Assembly.PartModel(id)
	if model then
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then d:Destroy()
			elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true; d.CanCollide = false; d.CanTouch = false end
		end
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
		model.Parent = vp
		local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
		local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.7 + 1
		local cam = mk("Camera", {FieldOfView = 40, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.new(dist * 0.45, dist * 0.3, -dist), cf.Position)}, vp)
		vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	else label(main, "MissingPreview", "?", UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.03), UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.4)) end
	label(main, "Name", def.Name, UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.48), UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.16))
	label(main, "Category", def.Slot .. " · " .. def.Rarity, UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.65), UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.1))
	label(main, "Status", equipped and "EQUIPPED" or owned and ("OWNED x" .. count) or "NOT OWNED",
		UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.77), UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.1), equipped and Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 150) or WHITE)
	label(main, "Price", def.Price == 0 and "FREE STARTER" or (Format.Abbreviate(def.Price) .. " Snow"),
		UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.88), UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.08))
end
local function render(state)
	if type(state) ~= "table" or type(state.Parts) ~= "table" then return end
	local key, owned = {}, 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		local n = tonumber(state.Parts[id]) or 0
		if n > 0 then owned += 1 end
		table.insert(key, id .. ":" .. n .. ":" .. tostring(state.Build and state.Build[C.Parts[id].Slot] == id))
	end
	index.Banner.Title.Text = ("PARTS %d/%d"):format(owned, #ids)
	local signature = table.concat(key, "|")
	if signature == lastSignature then return end
	lastSignature = signature
	for _, c in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
	for i, id in ipairs(ids) do partCard(id, i, state) end
end
Api.Changed.Event:Connect(function() render(Api.State) end)
render(Api.State)
task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("State") end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.state then render(res.state); return end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	index.Banner.Title.Text = "PARTS - RECONNECTING"
end)
index:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
	if index.Visible then render(Api.State) end
end)

-- snow bursts from the VFX pack (UniversalVFX): Impact on gains, PowerUp on MEGA DIG, Embers while at max combo
local VFX = require(RS:WaitForChild("UniversalVFX"))
local function hrpPart() local c = player.Character; return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
local lastBurst = 0
local function digBurst(scale)
	local hrp = hrpPart()
	if not hrp or os.clock() - lastBurst < 0.18 then return end
	lastBurst = os.clock()
	pcall(VFX.Burst, hrp, "Impact", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 246, 255), Scale = scale, Quality = 0.6, Offset = Vector3.new(0, -2.4, 0)})
end
local maxFx
local function setMaxFx(on)
	local hrp = hrpPart()
	if on and hrp and not (maxFx and maxFx.Root.Parent == hrp) then
		local ok, h = pcall(VFX.Attach, hrp, "Embers", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 230), Scale = 1.2})
		if ok then maxFx = h end
	elseif not on and maxFx then
		pcall(function() maxFx:Destroy() end)
		maxFx = nil
	end
end

local lastGain, lastCrunch, prevCombo = 0, 0, 0
local avgGain, lastMega = nil, 0
local function tierColors(combo)
	if combo >= COMBO_MAX then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 230), Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 200) end
	if combo >= 10 then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120), Color3.fromRGB(240, 150, 30) end
	return Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255), Color3.fromRGB(45, 120, 230)
end
local function showCallout(text, color)
	callout.Text, callout.TextColor3, callout.Visible, callout.TextTransparency = text, color, true, 0
	calloutScale.Scale = 0.4
	TweenService:Create(calloutScale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	task.delay(0.75, function()
		if callout.Text == text then
			TweenService:Create(callout, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.delay(0.3, function() if callout.Text == text then callout.Visible = false end end)
		end
	end)
end

collected.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(gained, combo, layers, mult)
	combo, layers, mult = tonumber(combo) or 0, tonumber(layers) or 0, tonumber(mult) or 1
	-- MEGA DIG = a payout at least 4x your recent average, at most once every 10 s (2026-10-04 v2)
	local g = tonumber(gained) or 0
	local isMega = avgGain ~= nil and g >= avgGain * 4 and os.clock() - lastMega > 10
	avgGain = avgGain and (avgGain * 0.9 + g * 0.1) or g
	if isMega then lastMega = os.clock() end
	lastGain = os.clock()
	if os.clock() - lastCrunch > 0.14 then
		lastCrunch = os.clock()
		crunch.PlaybackSpeed = 0.8 + math.min(combo, COMBO_MAX) * 0.025 + math.random() * 0.06
		crunch:Play()
	end
	digBurst(0.4 + math.min(combo, COMBO_MAX) * 0.025)
	if combo >= 1 then
		local a, b = tierColors(combo)
		grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(a, b)
		comboText.Text = (combo >= COMBO_MAX and "MAX COMBO x%.2f" or "COMBO x%.2f"):format(mult)
		meter.Visible = true
		meterScale.Scale = 1.12
		TweenService:Create(meterScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	end
	if isMega then
		showCallout("MEGA DIG!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120))
		bass:Play()
		local h = hrpPart()
		if h then pcall(VFX.Burst, h, "PowerUp", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120), Scale = 1}) end
	elseif combo >= COMBO_MAX and prevCombo < COMBO_MAX then
		showCallout("MAX COMBO! x2 SNOW", Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 230))
		shimmer:Play()
	elseif combo > prevCombo and combo % 5 == 0 and combo < COMBO_MAX then
		showCallout(("COMBO x%.2f!"):format(mult), Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120))
		shimmer:Play()
	end
	setMaxFx(combo >= COMBO_MAX)
	prevCombo = combo
end)
-- the timer bar drains; the meter hides when the combo expires
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not meter.Visible then return end
	local left = COMBO_WINDOW - (os.clock() - lastGain)
	if left <= 0 then
		meter.Visible = false
		prevCombo = 0
		setMaxFx(false)
		return
	end
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(left / COMBO_WINDOW, 0, 1), 1)
end)

local function smooth(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function unitFlat(v) local f = flat(v); if f.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end return f.Unit end
local function bounce(x)
	if x < 1 / 2.75 then return 7.5625 * x * x end
	if x < 2 / 2.75 then x -= 1.5 / 2.75; return 7.5625 * x * x + 0.75 end
	if x < 2.5 / 2.75 then x -= 2.25 / 2.75; return 7.5625 * x * x + 0.9375 end
	x -= 2.625 / 2.75
	return 7.5625 * x * x + 0.984375
end
local function fmtTime(s) s = math.max(0, math.floor(s + 0.5)); return ("%d:%02d"):format(s // 60, s % 60) end
local function NS(a, b) return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, b)}) end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function decor(o) o:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true); return o end

local function far(pos)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	return (cam.CFrame.Position - (pos or (ev and ev.Center) or cam.CFrame.Position)).Magnitude > C.VFX.CullDistance
end
local function count(n) return settings.Reduced and math.max(1, math.ceil(n / 3)) or n end
local function anchor(pos, life, size)
	local p = mk("Part", {Name = "FKAnchor", Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, Transparency = 1,
		Size = size or Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)}, fxFolder)
	if life then Debris:AddItem(p, life) end
	return p
end
local function emitter(parent, props)
	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.LightInfluence = 0.15
	for k, v in pairs(props) do e[k] = v end
	e.Parent = parent
	return e
end
local function puff(pos, color, n, size, speed)
	if far(pos) then return end
	local a = anchor(pos, 3)
	local e = emitter(a, {Texture = TX.smoke, Color = ColorSequence.new(color or WHITE), Size = NS(size or 2, (size or 2) * 2.2), Transparency = NS(0.25, 1),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1), Speed = NumberRange.new(speed or 8, (speed or 8) * 1.6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 60),
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Drag = 3, Rate = 0, RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60), Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)})
	e:Emit(count(n or 12))
end
local function paint(m, color, transp)
	for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= m.PrimaryPart then p.Color = color; p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; p.Transparency = transp; p.CastShadow = false end
	end
	return m
end
local function ringModel(pos, r, color, transp)
	local m = paint(Assets.TeleRing:Clone(), color, transp or 0.15)
	m.Parent = fxFolder
	m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, r / 10))
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
	return m
end
local function coneModel(origin, dir, range, color, transp)
	local m = paint(Assets.TeleCone:Clone(), color, transp)
	m.Parent = fxFolder
	m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, range / 10))
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + dir))
	return m
end
local function tpart(props)
	local p = mk("Part", {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false, Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end
	p.Parent = fxFolder
	return p
end
local function disc(pos, r, color, transp)
	return tpart({Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = Vector3.new(0.12, r * 2, r * 2), CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color = color, Transparency = transp or 0.55})
end
local function addTele(objs, expire, update) table.insert(tele, {objs = objs, expire = expire, update = update}) end
local function ringFade(pos, r0, r1, dur, color)
	if far(pos) then return end
	local m = ringModel(pos, r0, color or ICE, 0.1)
	local mp = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart")
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not m.Parent then conn:Disconnect(); return end
		local k = math.min(1, (os.clock() - t0) / dur)
		m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, (r0 + (r1 - r0) * smooth(k)) / 10))
		m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
		if mp then mp.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.9 * k end
		if k >= 1 then conn:Disconnect(); m:Destroy() end
	end)
end
local SHARD = Assets.IceShard:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart")
local function shards(pos, n, color)
	if far(pos) or not SHARD then return end
	for i = 1, count(n) do
		local s = SHARD:Clone()
		s.Anchored, s.CanCollide, s.CanQuery, s.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
		if color then s.Color = color end
		s.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6)
		s.Parent = fxFolder
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.6 + math.random() * 0.6, math.random() - 0.5).Unit
		local goal = pos + dir * (5 + math.random() * 6)
		TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {CFrame = CFrame.new(goal) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, 0)}):Play()
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			if s.Parent then TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {CFrame = CFrame.new(goal.X, (ev and ev.SnowY) or (goal.Y - 4), goal.Z), Transparency = 1}):Play() end
		end)
		Debris:AddItem(s, 1.2)
	end
end

local function sound(name, at, pitch)
	local s = SOUNDS[name]
	if not s then return end
	local parent = at and anchor(at, 8) or gui
	local snd = mk("Sound", {SoundId = s[1], Volume = s[2], PlaybackSpeed = s[3] * (pitch or 1), RollOffMinDistance = 30, RollOffMaxDistance = 420}, parent)
	snd:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(snd, 8)
end
local function shake(power, dur)
	if not settings.Shake or not display.pos then return end
	if (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - display.pos).Magnitude > C.VFX.ShakeDistance then return end
	local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < dur do
			local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * power * k, (math.random() - 0.5) * power * k, 0)
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
		hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
	end)
end
local function gy(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, ev.SnowY + 0.15, v.Z) end
local function bossPos() return display.pos or (ev and ev.Center) or Vector3.zero end

local function buildModel()
	if model then model:Destroy() end
	model = Assets.FrostKing:Clone()
	rootPart = model.PrimaryPart
	local base = rootPart.CFrame
	parts, crownParts, flipperParts, beakPart = {}, {}, {}, nil
	partList, cfList = {}, {}
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= rootPart then
			local g = p:GetAttribute("Group") or "Body"
			table.insert(parts, {part = p, group = g, rel = base:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)})
			if g == "Crown" then table.insert(crownParts, p) end
			if p.Name == "HeadBeak" and not beakPart then beakPart = p end
			if (g == "FlipperL" or g == "FlipperR") and (not flipperParts[g] or p.Size.Magnitude > flipperParts[g].Size.Magnitude) then flipperParts[g] = p end
		end
	end
	for _, g in ipairs({"FlipperL", "FlipperR", "FootL", "FootR", "Head", "Crown"}) do joints[g] = model:GetAttribute("Joint_" .. g) or Vector3.zero end
	model.Parent = fxFolder
end
local function about(j, rx, ry, rz) return CFrame.new(j) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx), math.rad(ry), math.rad(rz)) * CFrame.new(-j) end
local function pose()
	local t = now()
	local pos, dir = display.pos, display.dir
	local lean, roll, lift, spin, twist = 0, 0, 0.3 * math.sin(t * 2.1), 0, 0
	local abdL, abdR = 10 + 6 * math.sin(t * 3), 10 + 6 * math.sin(t * 3 + 0.7)
	local swL, swR, hp, hy = 0, 0, 0, 0
	local state = st and st.State or "Arrival"
	local walking = display.speed > 0.8 and state == "Fight"
	if walking then roll = 5 * math.sin(t * 9); lift += math.abs(math.sin(t * 9)) * 0.4 end
	if ev and t < ev.FightAt then -- rise out of the portal during the last 3 seconds of the arrival
		local k = math.clamp((t - (ev.FightAt - 3)) / 3, 0, 1)
		lift = -26 * (1 - k) ^ 2 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 30) * (1 - k)
	end
	local a = act
	if a and state == "Fight" then
		local u = t - a.T0
		local W, A, R = a.Windup, a.Active, a.Recover
		local k = a.Kind
		if k == "Slide" then
			if u < W then
				local s = smooth(u / W); lean = 16 * s; swL, swR = -40 * s, -40 * s; roll = math.sin(u * 30) * 1.5 * s
			elseif u < W + A then
				pos = a.Data.From:Lerp(a.Data.To, smooth((u - W) / A)); dir = unitFlat(a.Data.To - a.Data.From)
				lean = -80; lift = -1; swL, swR = -95, -95; abdL, abdR = 15, 15
			elseif u < W + A + R then
				local s = smooth((u - W - A) / R)
				pos = a.Data.To; dir = unitFlat(a.Data.To - a.Data.From); lean = -80 * (1 - s); swL, swR = -95 * (1 - s), -95 * (1 - s)
			end
		elseif k == "Barrage" then
			local s = smooth(math.min(1, u / math.max(0.01, W)))
			abdR = 10 + 140 * s; twist = -10 * s
			for _, b in ipairs(a.Data.Balls) do
				local e = t - b.Launch
				if e >= 0 and e < 0.25 then abdR = 150 - 110 * (e / 0.25); swR = 40 * (e / 0.25); twist = 12 end
			end
		elseif k == "Breath" then
			if u < W then
				local s = smooth(u / W); lean = 12 * s; hp = 25 * s; abdL, abdR = 10 + 35 * s, 10 + 35 * s; lift += 0.5 * s
			elseif u < W + A then
				lean = -8; hp = -12; roll = math.sin(u * 40) * 1.2; abdL, abdR = 40, 40
			elseif u < W + A + R then
				local s = smooth((u - W - A) / R); lean = -8 * (1 - s); hp = -12 * (1 - s)
			end
		elseif k == "Stomp" then
			local jump = a.Data.Jump or 0.6
			if u < W - jump then
				local s = smooth(u / math.max(0.01, W - jump)); lift = -1.2 * s; abdL, abdR = 10 + 40 * s, 10 + 40 * s
			elseif u < W then
				local s = (u - (W - jump)) / jump; lift = 13 * math.sin(math.pi * s); abdL, abdR = 150, 150
			elseif u < W + 0.35 then
				lift = -1.4 * (1 - (u - W) / 0.35); abdL, abdR = 30, 30
			end
		elseif k == "Spin" then
			if u < W then
				local s = smooth(u / W); abdL, abdR = 10 + 78 * s, 10 + 78 * s; lift = -0.6 * s; twist = math.sin(u * 20) * 4 * s
			elseif u < W + A then
				local e = u - W; spin = 900 * e * math.min(1, e / 0.3); abdL, abdR = 88, 88; lift = -0.6
			elseif u < W + A + R then
				local e = u - W - A; roll = 9 * math.sin(e * 6); hy = 18 * math.sin(e * 4); lean = 4 * math.sin(e * 5)
			end
		elseif k == "Stagger" then
			local s = math.min(1, u / math.max(0.01, A))
			roll = 7 * math.sin(u * 22) * (1 - s); lean = 14 * math.sin(s * math.pi); hp = 10 * math.sin(s * math.pi)
		end
	end
	local crownPop
	if state == "Defeat" then
		local u = t - (st.EndAt or t)
		lean = 95 * bounce(math.min(1, u / 1.1)); roll = 0; lift = 0
		abdL, abdR = 120 + 20 * math.sin(u * 14), 120 + 20 * math.sin(u * 14 + 1)
		crownPop = u
	elseif state == "Escape" then
		local u = t - (st.EndAt or t)
		lift = u < 0.5 and 6 * math.sin(math.pi * u / 0.5) or -28 * math.min(1, (u - 0.5) / 1.5)
	end
	local rootCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + dir) * CFrame.new(0, lift, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(twist), 0)
		* CFrame.new(0, 7, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(lean), 0, math.rad(roll)) * CFrame.new(0, -7, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spin), 0)
	local jl, jr = joints.FlipperL, joints.FlipperR
	local g = {
		FlipperL = about(jl, swL, 0, (jl.X >= 0 and 1 or -1) * abdL),
		FlipperR = about(jr, swR, 0, (jr.X >= 0 and 1 or -1) * abdR),
		Head = about(joints.Head, hp, hy, 0),
	}
	local stepA = walking and 14 * math.sin(t * 9) or 0
	g.FootL = about(joints.FootL, stepA, 0, 0)
	g.FootR = about(joints.FootR, -stepA, 0, 0)
	g.Crown = g.Head
	if crownPop then
		local u = math.min(crownPop, 1.1)
		g.Crown = g.Head * CFrame.new(0, 9 * u - 6 * u * u, 5 * u) * about(joints.Crown, u * 140, 0, u * 60)
	end
	rootPart.CFrame = rootCF
	for i, e in ipairs(parts) do
		partList[i] = e.part
		local gx = g[e.group]
		cfList[i] = gx and (rootCF * gx * e.rel) or (rootCF * e.rel)
	end
	workspace:BulkMoveTo(partList, cfList, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

local function telegraphCircle(pos, r, startT, endT)
	local p = gy(pos)
	local d = disc(p, r, DANGER, 0.6)
	local inner = disc(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.03, 0), 0.2, WARN, 0.3)
	local ring = ringModel(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0), r, WHITE, 0.1)
	addTele({d, inner, ring}, endT, function(t)
		local k = math.clamp((t - startT) / math.max(0.05, endT - startT), 0, 1)
		inner.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 2 * r * k, 2 * r * k)
		d.Transparency = 0.5 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 12)
	end)
end
local function telegraphLane(from, to, width, endT)
	local a, b = gy(from), gy(to)
	local len = math.max(1, (b - a).Magnitude)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b)
	local body = tpart({Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.12, len), CFrame = cf, Color = DANGER, Transparency = 0.6})
	local e1 = tpart({Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.14, len), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(width / 2, 0.02, 0), Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.1})
	local e2 = tpart({Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.14, len), CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-width / 2, 0.02, 0), Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.1})
	local objs = {body, e1, e2}
	local dv = (b - a).Unit
	for i = 1, 3 do table.insert(objs, coneModel(a + dv * (len * i / 4) + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0), dv, 3.5, WHITE, 0.2)) end
	addTele(objs, endT, function(t) body.Transparency = 0.5 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 14) end)
end
local function telegraphCone(origin, dir, range, endT)
	local m = coneModel(gy(origin), dir, range, DANGER, 0.55)
	local mp = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart")
	addTele({m}, endT, function(t) if mp then mp.Transparency = 0.45 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 12) end end)
end
local function telegraphStomp(d, endT)
	local c = gy(d.Center)
	local zone = disc(c, d.MaxRadius, WARN, 0.88)
	local slam = disc(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.02, 0), C.Boss.Radius + 2.5, DANGER, 0.55)
	local objs = {zone, slam}
	local rings = {}
	for i, rs in ipairs(d.Rings) do
		local m = ringModel(c + Vector3.new(0, -60, 0), d.Start, ICE, 0.05)
		rings[i] = {m = m, rs = rs}
		table.insert(objs, m)
	end
	addTele(objs, endT, function(t)
		slam.Transparency = t < d.Rings[1] and (0.45 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 16)) or 1
		for _, r in ipairs(rings) do
			local e = t - r.rs
			local rad = d.Start + d.Speed * e
			if e >= 0 and rad <= d.MaxRadius then
				r.m:ScaleTo(math.max(0.02, rad / 10))
				r.m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)))
			else
				r.m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(c + Vector3.new(0, -60, 0)))
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function trailOn(part, offA, offB, life, color)
	local a0 = mk("Attachment", {Position = offA}, part)
	local a1 = mk("Attachment", {Position = offB}, part)
	local tr = mk("Trail", {Attachment0 = a0, Attachment1 = a1, Lifetime = life, Color = ColorSequence.new(color or WHITE), Transparency = NS(0.15, 1),
		LightEmission = 0.5, FaceCamera = true, WidthScale = NS(1, 0.2)}, part)
	return function() tr.Enabled = false; Debris:AddItem(tr, life + 0.1); Debris:AddItem(a0, life + 0.1); Debris:AddItem(a1, life + 0.1) end
end
local function impactFX(pos, big)

	if far(pos) then return end
	pcall(VFX.Burst, anchor(pos, 3), "Impact", {Color = WHITE, Scale = big and 2.6 or 1.3})

local function throwBall(b)
	if not ev then return end
	local from = bossPos() + Vector3.new(0, 16, 0)
	local to = gy(b.Target) + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	local ball = Assets.Snowball:Clone()
	ball.Parent = fxFolder
	local main = ball.PrimaryPart
	if not settings.Reduced then
		local a0 = mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0)}, main)
		local a1 = mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.3, 0)}, main)
		mk("Trail", {Attachment0 = a0, Attachment1 = a1, Lifetime = 0.35, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, ICE), Transparency = NS(0.2, 1), LightEmission = 0.4, FaceCamera = true}, main)
	end
	sound("Throw", from)
	local dur = math.max(0.2, b.Land - now())
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not ball.Parent then conn:Disconnect(); return end
		local k = math.min(1, (os.clock() - t0) / dur)
		ball:PivotTo(CFrame.new(from:Lerp(to, k) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(math.pi * k) * 14, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(k * 9, k * 6, 0))
		if k >= 1 then conn:Disconnect(); ball:Destroy(); impactFX(to, false) end
	end)
end

local function finalAura()

local function at(a, sec, fn) task.delay(math.max(0, a.T0 + sec - now()), function() if act == a then fn() end end) end
local function onAction(a)
	act = a
	if not ev then return end
	local k = a.Kind
	local endT = a.T0 + a.Windup + a.Active
	if k == "Slide" then
		telegraphLane(a.Data.From, a.Data.To, a.Data.Width, endT)
		sound("Roar", bossPos(), 1.15)
		at(a, a.Windup, function()
			sound("Slide", bossPos())
			if not rootPart then return end
			local stops = {trailOn(rootPart, Vector3.new(4.5, 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(4.5, 2, 0), 1.6, WHITE), trailOn(rootPart, Vector3.new(-4.5, 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(-4.5, 2, 0), 1.6, WHITE)}
			local att = mk("Attachment", {Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, -6)}, rootPart)
			local spray = emitter(att, {Texture = TX.smoke, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Size = NS(2.5, 5), Transparency = NS(0.2, 1), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 18), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(50, 30), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Rate = settings.Reduced and 25 or 70, Drag = 2})
			local streak = (not settings.Reduced) and emitter(att, {Texture = TX.streak, Color = ColorSequence.new(ICE), Size = NS(1.2, 0.2), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5),
				Speed = NumberRange.new(25, 35), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 10), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back, Rate = 40, LightEmission = 1}) or nil
			task.delay(a.Active, function()
				for _, f in ipairs(stops) do f() end
				spray.Enabled = false
				if streak then streak.Enabled = false end
				Debris:AddItem(att, 1.2)
				if ev then puff(gy(a.Data.To), WHITE, 18, 3, 12) end
			end)
		end)
	elseif k == "Barrage" then
		for _, b in ipairs(a.Data.Balls) do
			telegraphCircle(b.Target, a.Data.Radius, a.T0, b.Land)
			at(a, b.Launch - a.T0, function() throwBall(b) end)
		end
	elseif k == "Breath" then
		telegraphCone(a.Data.Origin, a.Data.Dir, a.Data.Range, endT)
		sound("Inhale", bossPos())
		at(a, a.Windup, function() breathFX(a) end)
		at(a, a.Windup + a.Active, function() patchesFX(a) end)
	elseif k == "Stomp" then
		telegraphStomp(a.Data, endT)
		at(a, a.Windup, function()
			sound("Stomp", gy(a.Data.Center))
			impactFX(gy(a.Data.Center), true)
			shake(1.2, 0.35)
		end)
		if a.Data.Rings[2] then at(a, a.Data.Rings[2] - a.T0, function() sound("Stomp", gy(a.Data.Center), 1.15); puff(gy(a.Data.Center), WHITE, 14, 3, 12) end) end
	elseif k == "Spin" then
		local r = a.Data.Radius
		local d = disc(gy(bossPos()), r, DANGER, 0.6)
		local ring = ringModel(gy(bossPos()) + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0), r, WHITE, 0.1)
		addTele({d, ring}, endT, function(t)
			local p = gy(bossPos())
			d.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			ring:PivotTo(CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0)))
			d.Transparency = 0.5 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 14)
		end)
		at(a, a.Windup, function() spinFX(a) end)
		at(a, a.Windup + a.Active, function() dizzyFX(a) end)
	elseif k == "Stagger" then
		staggerFX()
	end
end

local function onState(s)
	if not ev then return end
	st = s

		local prev = lastState
		lastState = s.State
		if s.State == "Defeat" then act = nil; defeatFX()
		elseif s.State == "Escape" then act = nil; escapeFX()
		elseif s.State == "Fight" and prev == "Arrival" then showMsg("\u{2744} THE FROST KING ATTACKS!", ICE, 2) end
	end
	if (s.Phase or 1) >= 3 and s.State == "Fight" then finalAura() end
end

local function onReward(r)
	local lines = {}
	if r.Qualified then
		table.insert(lines, ("+%s \u{2744} Snow"):format(Format.Abbreviate(r.Snow or 0)))
		if r.Treasure then table.insert(lines, "\u{1F48E} Treasure: " .. tostring(r.Treasure)) end

			table.insert(lines, ("\u{26A1} %s for %d min"):format(nm, math.floor((r.BoostSeconds or 0) / 60)))
		end
	else
		table.insert(lines, ("Fight longer next time to earn rewards!\n(%d/%d s near the boss, %d/%d s hitting it)"):format(r.Engaged or 0, r.NeedEngaged or 0, r.Hit or 0, r.NeedHit or 0))
	end
	rewardTitle.Text = r.Result == "Victory" and "\u{1F3C6} VICTORY!" or "\u{2744} IT ESCAPED"
	rewardTitle.TextColor3 = r.Result == "Victory" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 150) or ICE
