	rewardScale.Scale = 0.5
	TweenService:Create(rewardScale, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	if r.Qualified and r.Result == "Victory" then
		local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then pcall(VFX.Burst, hrp, "PowerUp", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 120), Scale = 1.4}) end
	end
	task.delay(9, function() rewardPanel.Visible = false end)
end
event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(m)
	if type(m) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = m.T
	if kind == "Spawn" then
		onSpawn(m)
	elseif kind == "State" then
		onState(m)
	elseif kind == "Action" then
		if ev then onAction(m) end
	elseif kind == "Phase" then
		sound("Phase", display.pos)
		showMsg(m.Phase >= 3 and "\u{2744} FINAL PHASE! \u{2744}" or "PHASE II - it's getting angry!", m.Phase >= 3 and Color3.fromRGB(210, 170, 255) or ICE, 2.2)
		if m.Phase >= 3 then finalAura() end
	elseif kind == "Hit" then
		if m.Frost then flash(ICE, 0.82) else flash(DANGER, 0.55); sound("Hurt"); shake(0.5, 0.2) end
		local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and m.Push then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.3 + m.Push end
		if me then me.HP = m.HP end
	elseif kind == "Knocked" then
		knockToken += 1
		local my, untilT = knockToken, m.Until
		task.spawn(function()
			while knockToken == my and now() < untilT do
				showMsg(("KNOCKED OUT! Back in %d..."):format(math.ceil(untilT - now())), WARN, 1.1)
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end)
	elseif kind == "Recovered" then
		knockToken += 1
		showMsg("\u{2744} Back in the fight!", ICE, 1.5)
	elseif kind == "Me" then
		me = m
	elseif kind == "Reward" then
		onReward(m.Reward or {})
	elseif kind == "Cleanup" then
		cleanupAll()
	end
end)

local function hud()
	local t = now()
	local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pd = hrp and flat(hrp.Position - ev.Center).Magnitude or math.huge
	local near = pd < math.max(ev.W, ev.D) * 0.7 + 25
	local state = st and st.State or "Arrival"
	local live = state == "Arrival" or state == "Fight"
	if ann.Visible then
		annTime.Text = state == "Arrival" and ("Battle starts in " .. fmtTime(ev.FightAt - t)) or ("Battle in progress \u{2022} " .. fmtTime((st.Ends or t) - t) .. " left")
	end
	pill.Visible = live and not ann.Visible and not near
	if pill.Visible then
		pillText.Text = ("\u{2744} FROST KING \u{2022} %s"):format(state == "Arrival" and fmtTime(ev.FightAt - t) or fmtTime((st.Ends or t) - t))
	end
	bar.Visible = (near or me ~= nil) and (live or state == "Defeat")
	if bar.Visible and st then
		local f = math.clamp((st.HP or 0) / math.max(1, st.MaxHP or 1), 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(state == "Arrival" and 1 or f, 1)
		hpText.Text = state == "Arrival" and "ARRIVING..." or ("%d%%"):format(math.ceil(f * 100))
		local ph = st.Phase or 1
		barPhase.Text = ph >= 3 and "FINAL PHASE" or (ph == 2 and "PHASE II" or "PHASE I")
		barPhase.TextColor3 = ph >= 3 and Color3.fromRGB(210, 170, 255) or ICE
		barTime.Text = state == "Arrival" and fmtTime(ev.FightAt - t) or fmtTime((st.Ends or t) - t)
		fillGrad.Color = ph >= 3 and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(205, 150, 255), Color3.fromRGB(125, 70, 255)) or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 255))
	end
	mePanel.Visible = me ~= nil and live
	if mePanel.Visible then
		local hpv = math.max(0, me.HP or 0)
		meHPFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(hpv / (me.MaxHP or 100), 0, 1), 1)
		meHPText.Text = ("\u{2764} %d / %d"):format(math.ceil(hpv), me.MaxHP or 100)
		mePart.Text = me.Qualified and "\u{2714} Qualified for rewards!" or ("Fight %d/%ds \u{2022} Hit %d/%ds"):format(math.floor(me.Engaged or 0), me.NeedEngaged or 0, math.floor(me.Hit or 0), me.NeedHit or 0)
		mePart.TextColor3 = me.Qualified and Color3.fromRGB(160, 255, 170) or WHITE
		meReward.Text = ("Reward \u{2248} %s \u{2744}"):format(Format.Abbreviate(me.Reward or 0))
	end
	if markerPart then
		markerPart.Parent = live and fxFolder or nil
		if markerText then markerText.Text = ("\u{2744} FROST KING\n%s"):format(pd < 1e6 and (math.floor(pd) .. " studs") or ev.Name) end
	end
	local show = false
	if act and act.Kind == "Stomp" and hrp and state == "Fight" then
		local d = flat(hrp.Position - act.Data.Center).Magnitude
		for _, rs in ipairs(act.Data.Rings) do
			local rad = act.Data.Start + act.Data.Speed * (t - rs)
			if t >= rs - 0.6 and d <= act.Data.MaxRadius + 1 and d > rad - 1 and (d - rad) / act.Data.Speed < 0.8 then show = true end
		end
	end
	hint.Visible = show
end
local hudAcc = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not ev then return end
	if st and st.Pos then
		if not display.pos then display.pos = st.Pos; display.dir = unitFlat(st.Facing or display.dir) end
		local prev = display.pos
		display.pos = display.pos:Lerp(st.Pos, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 6))
		display.dir = unitFlat(display.dir:Lerp(unitFlat(st.Facing or display.dir), 1 - math.exp(-dt * 5)))
		display.speed = flat(display.pos - prev).Magnitude / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
	end
	if model and rootPart and display.pos then pcall(pose) end
	local t = now()
	for i = #tele, 1, -1 do
		local e = tele[i]
		if t >= e.expire then
			for _, o in ipairs(e.objs) do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy() end end
			table.remove(tele, i)
		elseif e.update then
			pcall(e.update, t)
		end
	end
	hudAcc += dt
	if hudAcc >= 0.1 then hudAcc = 0; pcall(hud) end
end)

-- MachineLocksClient: Pet Fuser and Crafting Machine look deep black and say
-- LOCKED until you own their unlock upgrade (UnlockFuser / UnlockCraft attributes).
-- Visual only; MachineService refuses locked machines on the server.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local MACHINES = {
	{Model = "PetFuser", Attr = "UnlockFuser", Label = "PET FUSER"},
	{Model = "CraftingMachine", Attr = "UnlockCraft", Label = "CRAFTING"},
}
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
-- "vanta black": black Neon ignores all lighting, so a locked machine is one flat silhouette (no shading, no edges)
local saved = {} -- strong table on purpose: weak Instance keys can be dropped while the part still exists
local function apply(model, label, locked)
	model:SetAttribute("LocalLocked", locked)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if d.Transparency < 1 or (saved[d] and saved[d].T < 1) then
				if not saved[d] then saved[d] = {C = d.Color, M = d.Material, T = d.Transparency, R = d.Reflectance} end
				local s = saved[d]
				if locked then
					d.Color, d.Material, d.Transparency, d.Reflectance = BLACK, Enum.Material.Neon, 0, 0
				else
					d.Color, d.Material, d.Transparency, d.Reflectance = s.C, s.M, s.T, s.R
				end
			end
		elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Light") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Enabled end
			d.Enabled = (not locked) and saved[d]
		elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Transparency end
			d.Transparency = locked and 1 or saved[d]
		elseif d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Enabled end
			d.Enabled = (not locked) and saved[d] -- no painted text on the silhouette
		elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") and d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("BillboardGui") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.Text end
			d.Text = locked and ("\u{1F512} " .. label) or saved[d] -- the floating sign still says what it is
		elseif d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = d.ActionText end
			d.ActionText = locked and "Locked" or saved[d]
		end
	end
end
local function setup(def)
	local village = workspace:WaitForChild("FrostfallVillage", 60)
	local model = village and village:WaitForChild(def.Model, 60)
	if not model then return end
	local function refresh() apply(model, def.Label, (tonumber(player:GetAttribute(def.Attr)) or 0) < 1) end
	refresh()
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(def.Attr):Connect(refresh)
end
for _, def in ipairs(MACHINES) do task.spawn(setup, def) end

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local WHITE, NAVY = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 85)
local GREEN, BLUE, ORANGE, GREY, ICE = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 105), Color3.fromRGB(70, 150, 245), Color3.fromRGB(250, 150, 50), Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 165), Color3.fromRGB(150, 225, 255)
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function round(o, r) return mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(r or 0.2, 0)}, o) end
local function outline(o, th, col) return mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = th or 2.5, Color = col or NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o) end
local function text(parent, str, props, th)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, Text = str, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextScaled = true, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = th or 2, Color = NAVY}, l)
	return l
end
local function button(parent, str, color, props)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = true, BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do b[k] = v end
	b:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	round(b, 0.28); outline(b, 3)
	mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235))}, b)
	text(b, str, {Name = "Label", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.76)}, 2.2)
	return b
end

local RANK, RCOL = {}, {}
for i, r in ipairs(C.Rarities) do RANK[r.Id] = i; RCOL[r.Id] = r.Color end
local totalW = 0
for _, d in pairs(C.Parts) do totalW += d.Weight end
local function chanceText(id)
	local w = C.Parts[id].Weight
	return w <= 0 and "Starter part" or ("1 in " .. Format.Abbreviate(math.floor(totalW / w + 0.5)))
end
local function brief(id)
	local d = C.Parts[id]
	local s = d.Stats
	if d.Slot == "Blade" then return ("Width %g  |  Soft x%g  |  Hard x%g"):format(s.Width, s.Soft, s.Hard)
	elseif d.Slot == "Engine" then return ("Top speed %g  |  Power x%g"):format(s.Speed, s.Power) end
	return ("Speed x%g  |  Grip %d%%  |  Steady x%g"):format(s.SpeedMult, math.floor(s.Traction * 100 + 0.5), s.Stability)
end
local function snowNow()
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local s = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Snow")
	return s and s.Value or 0
end
local function clientMods()
	return {PowerMult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1, PowerBonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0, SizeMult = player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1,
		ReachMult = player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1, SpinMult = player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1}
end

local state
local refreshAll
local function call(action, a, b, c)
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(action, a, b, c) end)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		if res.state then state = res.state; Api.State = state; Api.Changed:Fire() end
		return res
	end
	return {ok = false, msg = "Connection problem - try again."}
end

-- 3D previews (the real Blender models), slowly orbiting
local previews = {}
local function visible(o)
	while o and o ~= pg do
		if o:IsA("GuiObject") and not o.Visible then return false end
		if o:IsA("ScreenGui") and not o.Enabled then return false end
		o = o.Parent
	end
	return true
end
local function setPreview(vp, model, distMul)
	vp:ClearAllChildren()
	if not model then previews[vp] = nil return end
	model.Parent = vp
	local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = mk("Camera", {FieldOfView = 35}, vp)
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	previews[vp] = {cam = cam, center = cf.Position, dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * (distMul or 1.7) + 2, h = size.Y * 0.18}
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local a = os.clock() * 0.7
	for vp, e in pairs(previews) do
		if vp.Parent and visible(vp) then
			e.cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(e.center + Vector3.new(math.sin(a) * e.dist, e.h + e.dist * 0.3, math.cos(a) * e.dist), e.center)
		end
	end
end)
local function viewport(parent, props)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 48, 96), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 195), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1.4, -1)}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do vp[k] = v end
	round(vp, 0.08)
	return vp
end

local function offerNow()
	if not state then return nil end
	if target == "Reserved" then return state.Reserved end
	return state.Offers and state.Offers[target] or nil
end
local shownKey
local function refreshCard()
	if not state then return end
	local o, r = offerNow(), state.Reserved
	local isRes = target == "Reserved"
	local snow = snowNow()
	for _, g in ipairs({vp, nameL, rarPill, slotL, chanceL, descL, statL, priceL, needL, track, glow, buyB}) do g.Visible = o ~= nil end
	resB.Visible = o ~= nil and not isRes
	rerB.Visible = not isRes
	rerB.Label.Text = o and "REROLL" or "ROLL"
	if o then
		local def = C.Parts[o.Part]
		local col = RCOL[def.Rarity]
		hdr.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(NAVY, 0.3)
		nameL.Text, rarL.Text, slotL.Text, chanceL.Text = def.Name, def.Rarity:upper(), def.Slot:upper(), chanceText(o.Part)
		rarPill.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(NAVY, 0.25)
		descL.Text, statL.Text = def.Desc, brief(o.Part)
		priceL.Text = "\u{2744} " .. Format.Abbreviate(o.Price)
		local owned = state.Parts[o.Part] or 0
		if snow >= o.Price then
			needL.Text, needL.TextColor3 = owned > 0 and ("Ready! (you own " .. owned .. ")") or "Ready to buy!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 170)
		else
			needL.Text, needL.TextColor3 = "You need " .. Format.Abbreviate(math.ceil(o.Price - snow)) .. " more Snow", Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120)
		end
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(o.Price <= 0 and 1 or math.clamp(snow / o.Price, 0, 1), 1)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = snow >= o.Price and GREEN or ORANGE
		buyB.BackgroundColor3 = snow >= o.Price and GREEN or GREY
		glow.ImageColor3 = col
		if shownKey ~= target .. o.Token then
			shownKey = target .. o.Token
			setPreview(vp, Assembly.PartModel(o.Part), 1.15)
		end
		hdrText.Text = isRes and "YOUR RESERVED PART" or ("PEDESTAL " .. target .. " - FOR SALE!")
	else
		shownKey = nil
		setPreview(vp, nil)
		hdr.BackgroundColor3 = ICE
		hdrText.Text = isRes and "NOTHING RESERVED" or ("PEDESTAL " .. target .. " - ROLL IT!")
	end
	if r and not isRes then
		local def = C.Parts[r.Part]
		resStrip.Visible = true
		resText.Text = ("\u{2B50} %s  \u{2744}%s  %s"):format(def.Name, Format.Abbreviate(r.Price), snow >= r.Price and "READY!" or ("need " .. Format.Abbreviate(math.ceil(r.Price - snow))))
		resFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(r.Price <= 0 and 1 or math.clamp(snow / r.Price, 0, 1), 1)
		resBuy.BackgroundColor3 = snow >= r.Price and GREEN or GREY
	else
		resStrip.Visible = false
	end
end

local function reveal(rank)
	local big = rank >= C.Shop.BigRevealRank
	local col = RCOL[C.Rarities[rank].Id]
	cardScale.Scale = big and 0.78 or 0.93
	TweenService:Create(cardScale, TweenInfo.new(big and 0.45 or 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	glow.ImageTransparency = big and 0.1 or 0.65
	TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(big and 1.8 or 0.5), {ImageTransparency = big and 0.5 or 0.82}):Play()
	vp.Ambient = big and Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 195)
	vp.LightColor = big and col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.45) or WHITE
	if big then
		flash.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6); flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
		TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		sfx("rbxassetid://125078105193243", 0.55, 1)
	else
		sfx("rbxassetid://12221976", 0.5, 1.5)
	end
end

local function showCard(on) card.Visible = on; if on then confirm.Visible = false; refreshCard() end end
closeB.Activated:Connect(function() showCard(false) end)
local function doRoll(key, inCard)
	key = key or target
	local r = call("Roll", key)
	if r.ok then
		refreshAll()
		if inCard then -- rerolled from the open card: it stays open
			target = key
			showCard(true)
			reveal(r.rank or 2)
		else -- rolled at the pedestal: no pop-up - the part appears on its pedestal (E there opens the offer, R rerolls)
			Api.Revealed(key, r.rank or 2)
			local o = state and state.Offers and state.Offers[key]
			if o then
				local def = C.Parts[o.Part]
				toast(("%s - %s  \u{2744}%s"):format(def.Name, def.Rarity, Format.Abbreviate(o.Price)), RCOL[def.Rarity]:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3))
			end
		end
	else
		toast(r.msg or "Couldn't roll.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120))
	end
end
rerB.Activated:Connect(function() doRoll(target, true) end)
local function afterBuy(r)
	if r.ok then showCard(false); sfx("rbxassetid://12221976", 0.6, 0.9); toast(r.msg .. " Equip it at the WORKBENCH!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 170)) else toast(r.msg or "Couldn't buy.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120)) end
	refreshAll()
end
buyB.Activated:Connect(function()
	local o = offerNow()
	if o then afterBuy(call("Buy", target, o.Token)) end
end)
resBuy.Activated:Connect(function()
	if state and state.Reserved then afterBuy(call("Buy", "Reserved", state.Reserved.Token)) end
end)
resB.Activated:Connect(function()
	local o = offerNow()
	if not o then return end
	local r = call("Reserve", target, o.Token, false)
	if r.needConfirm then
		confirmText.Text = ("Replace your reserved %s with %s?"):format(C.Parts[state.Reserved.Part].Name, C.Parts[o.Part].Name)
		confirm.Visible = true
	elseif r.ok then showCard(false); toast(r.msg, Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)) else toast(r.msg or "Couldn't reserve.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120)) end
	refreshAll()
end)
yesB.Activated:Connect(function()
	confirm.Visible = false
	local o = offerNow()
	if not o then return end
	local r = call("Reserve", target, o.Token, true)
	if r.ok then showCard(false) end
	toast(r.msg or "Couldn't reserve.", r.ok and Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120))
	refreshAll()
end)

local garage, gl = nil, {}
local function buildSignature(b) return tostring(b.Blade) .. "|" .. tostring(b.Engine) .. "|" .. tostring(b.Gear) end
local function refreshGarage()
	if not garage or not state then return end
	local b = state.Build
	local sig = buildSignature(b)
	if gl.sig ~= sig then
		gl.sig = sig
		setPreview(gl.vp, Assembly.Build(b), 1.35)
	end
	local st = C.StatsFor(b, clientMods())
	local lines = {
		("Top speed: %d"):format(math.floor(st.MaxSpeed + 0.5)), ("Clearing power: %s"):format(st.ClearPower < 100 and ("%.1f"):format(st.ClearPower) or Format.Abbreviate(math.floor(st.ClearPower + 0.5))),
		("Blade width: %.1f"):format(st.BladeWidth), ("Soft snow: x%.1f   Hard snow: x%.1f"):format(st.Soft, st.Hard),
		("Grip: %d%%   Steady: x%.1f"):format(math.floor(st.Traction * 100 + 0.5), st.Stability),
	}
	for i, l in ipairs(gl.stats) do l.Text = lines[i] or "" end
	gl.warn.Text = (st.Valid and "") or "Needs an engine and running gear to drive!"
	gl.list:ClearAllChildren()
	mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, gl.list)
	local order = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(C.Slots) do
		order += 1
		local head = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 36), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, gl.list)
		text(head, slot:upper(), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = ICE})
		local un = button(head, "UNEQUIP", GREY, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.8)})
		un.Visible = b[slot] ~= nil
		un.Activated:Connect(function()
			local r = call("Unequip", slot)
			toast(r.msg or "", r.ok and Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120)); refreshAll()
		end)
		local ids = {}
		for id, def in pairs(C.Parts) do if def.Slot == slot and (state.Parts[id] or 0) > 0 then table.insert(ids, id) end end
		table.sort(ids, function(x, y) return C.Parts[x].Price < C.Parts[y].Price end)
		for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
			order += 1
			local def = C.Parts[id]
			local equipped = b[slot] == id
			local row = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 62), BackgroundColor3 = equipped and Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 66, 128), LayoutOrder = order}, gl.list)
			row:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true); round(row, 0.18); outline(row, 2.5, equipped and GREEN or NAVY)
			mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -10), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 5), BackgroundColor3 = RCOL[def.Rarity], BorderSizePixel = 0}, row):SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)

-- PlowTutorialClient (2026-10-04, Claude): the Snowplow-mode starter tutorial.
--   receive snowplow -> drive into the snow -> earn Snow -> roll a part offer -> buy it -> equip it in the garage.
-- Finishing or skipping is remembered through PlowService (TutorialDone).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local C = require(RS:WaitForChild("PlowConfig"))
if C.Mode ~= "Snowplow" then return end
local remote = RS:WaitForChild("PlowRemote")
local event = RS:WaitForChild("PlowEvent")
local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local FONT, WHITE, NAVY = Enum.Font.FredokaOne, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 85)
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local sg = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "PlowTutorial", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 46, IgnoreGuiInset = true, Enabled = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling}, pg)
local box = mk("Frame", {Name = "Box", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 73, 122), BackgroundTransparency = 0.2}, sg)
box:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)}, box)
mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 215, 255), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, box)
mk("UIPadding", {PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 26), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 26), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14)}, box)
local boxScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, box)
local label = mk("TextLabel", {Name = "Text", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Font = FONT, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextSize = 28, Text = ""}, box)
local skip = mk("TextButton", {Name = "Skip", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 38), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
	AutoButtonColor = true, Font = FONT, TextSize = 20, TextColor3 = NAVY, Text = "SKIP", ZIndex = 6}, box)
skip:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)}, skip)
mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, skip)
mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(190, 218, 248))}, skip)
local arrow = mk("TextLabel", {Name = "Arrow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, Text = "\u{25BC}", TextSize = 44, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 50),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Visible = false, ZIndex = 20}, sg)
mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = NAVY}, arrow)

local cancelled, running, target = false, false, nil
local generation = 0
local fades = {}
local function say(t)
	label.Text = t
	boxScale.Scale = 0.88
	TweenService:Create(boxScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Scale = 1}):Play()
end
local function waitUntil(cond, timeout)
	local token = generation
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while not cond() do
		if cancelled or token ~= generation then return false end
		task.wait(0.25)
		if timeout and os.clock() - t0 > timeout then return false end
	end
	return not cancelled and token == generation
end
local function snow()
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local s = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Snow")
	return s and s.Value or 0
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local obj = target and target()
	if obj and obj.Parent and obj.Visible then
		arrow.Visible = true
		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(obj.AbsolutePosition.X + obj.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, obj.AbsolutePosition.Y - 4 - math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 12)
	else
		arrow.Visible = false
	end
end)
local function finish(token)
    if token ~= generation then return end
    target = nil
    fades = {
        TweenService:Create(box, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}),
        TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 1}),
    }
    for _, tw in ipairs(fades) do tw:Play() end
    task.wait(0.3)
    if token ~= generation then return end
    sg.Enabled = false
    box.BackgroundTransparency, label.TextTransparency = 0.2, 0
    running = false
    pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("TutorialDone") end)
end
skip.Activated:Connect(function() cancelled = true end)
local function run()
	if running then return end
	generation += 1
	local token = generation
	cancelled = false
	running = true
	-- Loading and data readiness replace the retired arrival cinematic.
    if not waitUntil(function()
        return player.Character ~= nil and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") ~= nil
            and player:GetAttribute("LoadingReady") == true
            and player:GetAttribute("LoadingScreenActive") ~= true
            and player:GetAttribute("IntroActive") ~= true
    end, 60) then if token == generation then running = false end return end
	local r
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer("State") end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.state then r = res break end
		if token ~= generation then return end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	if token ~= generation then return end
	if not r or r.state.TutorialDone then running = false return end
	sg.Enabled = true
	say("Your SNOWPLOW is ready!\nPress DRIVE to hop in.")
	target = function() local g = pg:FindFirstChild("PlowDriveGui"); return g and g:FindFirstChild("Drive") end
	if waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("PlowDriving") == true or player:GetAttribute("InGarage") == true end) then
		target = nil
		local base = snow()
		say("Drive into the snow to clear it and earn Snow!\n(WASD or the thumbstick)")
		if waitUntil(function() return snow() - base >= 40 or player:GetAttribute("InGarage") == true end) then
			say("Nice! Tap GARAGE to teleport to the part pedestals.")
			target = function() return pg:FindFirstChild("Garage", true) end
			if waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("InGarage") == true end) then
				target = nil
				say("Walk to a pedestal and press E to ROLL a part!")
				if waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("PlowOffered") == true end) then
					say("That part is FOR SALE!\nPress E at the pedestal again to open it and BUY -\nor RESERVE it to save up. (R = reroll)")
					waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("PlowBought") == true end, 300)
					if not cancelled and token == generation then
						say("Use the WORKBENCH (press E) to EQUIP your new part!")
						waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("PlowEquipped") == true end, 150)
						if not cancelled and token == generation then
							say("Tap LOBBY to go back, then DRIVE!")
							target = function() return pg:FindFirstChild("Garage", true) end
							waitUntil(function() return player:GetAttribute("InGarage") ~= true end, 60)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	finish(token)
end
event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind)
    if kind ~= "TutorialReset" then return end
    generation += 1
    cancelled, running, target = true, false, nil
    for _, tw in ipairs(fades) do tw:Cancel() end
    fades = {}
    sg.Enabled = false
    box.BackgroundTransparency, label.TextTransparency = 0.2, 0
    task.defer(run)
end)
task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(2)
	if not running then run() end
end)
